description: This Java class 'PsiProjectListener' extends 'PsiTreeChangeAdapter' and manages PSI tree change events within an Android Studio plugin environment. It tracks relevant resource files, manages listeners for project resource directories, and dispatches events related to file and directory changes, including additions, removals, replacements, moves, and property changes.

classes.name: PsiProjectListener
classes.description: A listener class that monitors PSI tree changes in an Android Studio project, managing resource file events and notifying resource repositories accordingly.

methods.name: addRoot
methods.description: Adds a resource root directory and associates it with a resource repository.

methods.name: removeRoot
methods.description: Removes a resource root directory and its associated repository.

methods.name: getListener
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of PsiProjectListener for a given project.

methods.name: childAdded
methods.description: Handles PSI tree events when a child element is added, dispatching to relevant resource repositories.

methods.name: childRemoved
methods.description: Handles PSI tree events when a child element is removed, dispatching to relevant resource repositories.

methods.name: childReplaced
methods.description: Handles PSI tree events when a child element is replaced, including special handling for Groovy files and Gradle extensions.

methods.name: childrenChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to children of PSI elements.

methods.name: childMoved
methods.description: Handles PSI tree events when a child element is moved, including cross-resource directory moves.

methods.name: beforePropertyChange
methods.description: Handles pre-change events for properties, such as file name changes.

methods.name: propertyChanged
methods.description: Handles property change events, such as file renaming.
